stem.en: A Harappan trader has one each of the small weights 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16. Which weights together balance a load of exactly 13 units?

feedback.en: These add up to 13, but the doubling set has no 5 weight.
These add up to 13, but the trader has only one 2 weight.
These add up to 17, which is more than the load.

explanation.en: 8 + 4 + 1 = 13. The small Harappan weights go up in doubling steps, and one of each is enough to make up any whole number up to their total.

hints.en: Start with the biggest weight that is not more than 13, then see what is left.
